main_text.head: PER QVAM ILLVSTRIS, ET FILI INSTAR DILECTISSIMÆ IN DOMINO.
main_text.p: SPIÆ[?] deuotissimi quondam patris tui animæ renunciaretur de relictis abs te studiis, & spretâ gubernatione mea; certè tui huius instituti rationem vbicunq; etiám locorum degeret, quàm maximè essetimprobatura. Siquidem vltrà modum amans te pater, & salutis tuæ cupidus, quum neq; meliori præsidio, neq; tutelæ magis securæ, quàm nostræ, committi te posse intelligeret; ab ipsis mox incunabulis, & vixdum etiam pedibus recta incedentem ad Ecclesiam & Collegium nostrum adduxit: vbi te omnibus Patribus cognoscendum exhibens, singulatim commendauit. Et quia tunc ego præter reliquos omnes, indolis tuæ viuacitate, & forma huic conueniente captus me illi obtuli, vt tui curam haberem, teq; erudiendo instituerem: ille, cum primis se fortunatum inde prædicans, palàm confessus est, sibi in hac vita nihil isto iucundius accidisse. page.notes: Woodcut initial S with the following word "PIÆ" in capitals: the reading "SPIÆ" is uncertain; the first letters beside the initial are hard to make out. The top of the first column shows faint ghosting of ornament and text below the title (show-through, not transcribed). A small stray mark "/" lies at the lower left, not transcribed. Printed spellings kept as they appear: "essetimprobatura" (space missing in print), "accidisse". The word "renunciaretur" is partly obscured on the scan. Heading, last line and catchword "aduersa" are read from the scan with moderate confidence.
